label: Index Reel
description: The Listicle's FAST version (SPEC-creator-formats.md, recipes index-reel-host / index-reel-page): one claim pinned at the top for the whole scene ("12 lifecycle emails in 12 seconds"), a phone-frame example that swaps about every 0.9 s, and the count (3/12) so the viewer knows how far in they are. mode host: over the person -- the headline on a white plate, the phone away from the face, the item's name under it. mode page: an opaque designed page -- headline, a numbered list that fills in step with the examples (the current one in the brand color), the phone beside it. An item with no src draws its own example: an email (sender, subject, preview, a button), so a reel needs no screenshots to look finished. Places itself on the whole stage.

headline.label: The pinned claim; *word* in the brand color

items.label: The examples in order: {title, src?, subject?, preview?, from?, cta?, at?}

title.description: The item's name (the list row, the label under the phone)

src.description: A screenshot of the example; omit to draw an email

preview.description: Drawn email: one or two lines of the body

from.description: Drawn email: the sender (default the data's from)

at.description: Seconds (or a word anchor) this item lands; default start_at + i * per_item_s

mode.label: host (default: over the person) | page (an opaque designed page with the numbered list)
